title: Operational Range Bounding in Spectroscopy: A Safety Cage Framework for Machine Learning Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ensuring the reliability of black-box machine learning models in safety-critical space missions remains a significant challenge, particularly when ground-truth is unavailable for validation. Although machine learning models offer a powerful means to augment standard pipelines by extracting transmission spectra from complex exoplanetary light curves, their susceptibility to unmodelled instrument anomalies, stellar activity, and domain shifts introduces unquantified risks. This study evaluates a modular safety cage architecture that operates as a parallel monitoring layer to assess the validity of a prediction without modifying the underlying estimator. By monitoring different runtime indicators, including uncertainty quantification, out-of-domain detection, and influence functions, the framework constrains the model's operational domain to a verified region. translated_title: 光谱学中的操作范围界定：一种面向机器学习模型的安全笼框架
translated_abstract: 在安全关键的太空任务中，确保黑盒机器学习模型的可靠性仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在缺乏真值数据可供验证的情况下。尽管机器学习模型通过从复杂的地外行星光变曲线中提取透射光谱，为增强标准处理流程提供了强大手段，但其易受未建模的仪器异常、恒星活动以及领域偏移的影响，从而引入了未量化的风险。本研究评估了一种模块化的安全笼架构，该架构作为一个并行监控层运行，在不修改底层估计器的情况下评估预测结果的有效性。通过监控多种运行时指标，包括不确定性量化、域外检测和影响函数，该框架将模型的操作域约束在经过验证的区域内。研究还在域内和跨域条件下进行了受控评估。
tldr: 本文提出一种“安全笼”框架，通过并行监控不确定性量化、域外检测和影响函数等运行时指标，在不修改底层模型的情况下将机器学习模型的操作范围约束在经验证的区域内，从而提升安全关键太空任务（如地外行星透射光谱提取）中黑盒模型预测的可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a "safety cage" framework that bounds a machine learning model's operational domain to a verified region by monitoring runtime indicators such as uncertainty quantification, out-of-domain detection, and influence functions in parallel—without modifying the underlying estimator—thereby enhancing the reliability of black-box predictions in safety-critical space missions such as exoplanet transmission spectroscopy.
